summary: This clinical trial is testing the effects of semaglutide versus a placebo on body composition in adults with type 1 diabetes and overweight or obesity. Participants will be randomly assigned to take either the study drug or a placebo once a week for 24 weeks. The study is currently Recruiting and aims to enroll 40 people. Researchers want to see how these treatments affect lean mass over the course of the study.
